parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78) between `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.returnsV1WhenFeatureFlagIsV1` and `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.invalidFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` is expected in a test file: each test method exercises a distinct scenario (valid feature-flag path vs. invalid fallback path) and the shared shape is an artifact of the XCTest method pattern, not unintentional duplication. Merging or abstracting these test methods would obscure the distinct intent of each test case and couple unrelated assertions.
